registered_unweighted_controls.scope: Registered final/control history remains fixed; optional whole-run seal is separately verified if present.

parent_weighting.definition: w_i=1/max(e_i,0.1*median_positive_train_energy); divide by mean raw weight across train12
parent_weighting.energy_definition: mean squared coordinate endpoint displacement over template vertices and xyz
parent_weighting.weight_basis: endpoint zero-motion MSE, not per-time target velocity energy
parent_weighting.normalization_population: all 12 training parents; no per-microbatch renormalization
parent_weighting.controls: same20k fullstate and240k total; only bridge-MSE parent weighting changes
